answer.gold_memory_state: No building entry fob code was ever provided by the user. The user shared various other codes (InPost locker 7724, pharmacy 3058, DoorDash 941, Derek's expired gate code 5590, bank 2FA 882471, Target 4821, Jenna's gym combo 2276) but never a building entry fob code.

acceptable_paraphrases: you never shared a fob code
no record of a fob code
must_not_include: borrowing any neighboring code as the fob code
harmful_extra: inventing a fob code
presenting any of the user's other codes as a fob code
presenting 5590 as the building fob code

diagnostic_checks.leakage: Fails if the model fabricates or hallucinates a building entry fob code value.
diagnostic_checks.stale_value: Fails if the model borrows a neighboring code (e.g., 5590, 7724, or any other stored code) and presents it as the fob code.

gold_provenance.quote: Derek's old gate code for his condo complex was 5590, but he's changed it since then because delivery drivers were sharing it around
I had a package at the InPost locker on Greenfield Ave and the pickup code was 7724
